reply_text:
I replied to Dana in the #north-team thread: the figure is 261 seats. Ilse posted it in that channel on Oct 14 as the seat count for the Quarrendon Freight Lines 2026 renewal.

I couldn't find any renewal contract or order form in the shared files to check it against, so I suggested Dana confirm with Ilse before marking it settled in the tracker. I also noted that the 185 seats from the Aug 2025 Amendment No. 1 is not the renewal count. Seat counts aren't money figures and Dana is on the North team, so sharing it there was fine.
